data.name: Doo 'N' Dash
data.detailed_description:
They closed the loo? Time to make a stinky poo!

Doo N Dash is a first-of-it's-kind Stealth N' Stench adventure.

Play as Loo‑is, an overworked office drone with an urgent biological crisis. The bathroom is closed, the pressure is rising, and your coworkers are everywhere. Sneak through cubicles, hallways, and break rooms while hunting for creative receptacles like coffee mugs, trash cans, and anything else that can contain the… situation.

Blend in by yanking up your pants and pretending to work at the nearest desk, avoid suspicious coworkers, and try not to leave a trail. If they catch you in the act, you're fired!

Hold it together. Stay stealthy. And most of all… don’t let it blow.



💩 Features:

  • Stealth‑N‑Stench Gameplay
    Sneak, hide, and outsmart coworkers who can literally smell trouble.

  • Creative “Receptacle” Hunting
    Coffee mugs, trash cans, potted plants — if it holds poo, it must doo...

  • Dynamic Office AI
    Coworkers wander, chat, investigate smells, and react to your suspicious behavior.

  • Hide!
    Pull up your pants and get back to work, chat on the phone or read the news to hide in plain sight.

  • Pressure Meter Madness
    Manage your internal “timer” before things get explosively out of hand.

  • Multiple Office Zones
    Explore cubicles, kitchens, meeting spaces, and more as you search for relief.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel I5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 1650)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
